title: Marcus Corporation Promotes Rajiv W. Castellino to Chief Information Officer
summary: Marcus Corporation (NYSE: MCS) today announced that Rajiv W. Castellino, chief technology officer of Marcus Hotels Resorts, has been promoted to chief information officer of Marcus Corporation. Castellino will assume the role on August 2, 2026, succeeding Kim M. Lueck, who will retire as chief information officer on August 1, 2026, after nearly 30 years with the company. “Rajiv has consistently aligned technology strategies to drive revenue, improve efficiency, and strengthen the long-term success of Marcus Hotels Resorts,” said Gregory S. Marcus, chief executive officer of Marcus Corporation. “I am confident he will bring the same focus and discipline as he assumes leadership of our enterprise-wide technology strategy and infrastructure. Congratulations to Rajiv for this well-deserved promotion.” Castellino began his career at Marcus Hotels Resorts in 2017 as chief technology officer.
